title: 2018 MIPS Eligibility Tool Has Been Released
titleTag: 2018 MIPS Eligibility Tool Has Been Released
description: The 2018 MIPS Eligibility Tool has been released. Find out what you need to know about new MIPS updates, and how to remain compliant.
body:
MIPS Participation Tool

The Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) announced the MIPS Participation Tool has been updated. You can now check on your 2018 eligibility for the Merit-based Incentive Payment System (MIPS).

What is the 2018 MIPS Eligibility Tool?

For 2018, there have been changes to the Low-Volume Threshold. According to CMS this should reduce the burden on smaller practices, like clinicians, if they:

  • B illed $90,000 or less in Medicare Part B charges for covered professional services under the Physician Fee Schedule (PFS)

OR

  • They furnished covered professional services, under the PFS to 200 or fewer Medicare Part B -enrolled beneficiaries

Click HERE to enter your National Provider Identifier (NPI) to find out whether you need to participate during the 2018 performance year.
